entries.description: the chain result was supplied by the caller and not recomputed by this exporter; the caller reports that no modification was detected; the caller reports the Ed25519 signatures as verified; this exporter did not check them; suffix truncation and events that were never written lie outside both checks, because detecting them needs an anchor kept outside the file.
